verdict.rationale: Kling documents automation-adjacent features: a node-based canvas, batch production, an agent, and MCP/CLI access. The pack contains no evidence that users can version, review, or roll back those automations or workflows. The API changelog and model_name parameter cover API and model versioning, not versioning of user automations, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
